notes.title: First patch is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478205/a22f0fc754fa017c1d0a04237908247553d986f5.png[/img]

Here is what was fixed and what changed:
[list]
[*] added separate graphics settings window with additional quality and display selectors, and fullscreen toggle
[*] added separate sound settings window with volume slider for master, sfx, ambient, ui and voices
[*] fixed bug when mining too many rocks in short time caused rocks to not destroy properly
[*] fixed scroll in quest board and quests not selecting on hover
[*] fixed hell guard boss minions not destroying after leaving to another cave or leaving combat zone
[*] fixed fixed slime boss leaving slime in other caves
[*] fixed bug when first waypoint in cave might become locked (which could cause soft lock in cave 18)
[*] stopped chickens from flying through mountain rocks
[*] updated model for third hub
[*] some audio fixes
[*] info action now detects input device
[*] gems are visible in crystal cave
[/list]
